groups.contract: Metal finite arithmetic and raster bounds
groups.evidence: Public textures validates Metal and size32..1024 before bake. Density<=3000 and length<=.4 make density*5<=15000, most_steps<=822 and n*n<=1048576; finish3 words and slopes2 words widen allocations to u64. Scratch atomic maximum only accepts positive groove bits; deterministic RNG wrapping deliberate. Output byte roughness saturation intentional. Image dimensions and decoded pixel cardinality belong engraving decoder already read531; arbitrary raw ReliefImage is not exposed through this public bake API.

Validated repeats1..8, strands1..6, positive tiles through Engraving, size>=32 keep soft/period denominators positive. Zero legal motif amplitude/leaf is guarded by max(room,soft) or max(axis,soft), not incorrectly rejected. Finite color/roughness admitted. No GPU result or cross-device determinism run claimed.
